'''Vanus Cruor''' was a [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] who ascended the ranks of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] crime syndicate known as the [[Exchange]] to become one of its top agents. At some point, the [[Corellian Security Force]] possessed a pixelated [[Hologram/Legends|holo-image]] of Cruor's first meeting with a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]]. The image depicted Cruor with his [[Limb/Legends|arm]] affectionately draped around the [[Weapon/Legends|armed]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] while she held up a bottle of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] so he could drink from it.<ref name="The Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vanus Cruor was mentioned in Kaliyo Djannis's entry in [[The Holonet]], a web feature created to promote [[BioWare]]'s then-upcoming [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="The Holonet" /> which was ultimately released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR2">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Cruor was intended to appear in the game itself in the Imperial mission "The Excavators," but the mission was cut before the game's release.<ref name="TOR">Internal game files from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the fully-qualified name of Cruor's NPC: ''location.tatooine.mob.imperial.the_excavators.vanus_cruor''</ref>
